$comment: Ground truth for test/fixtures.test.js. Every bug planted in this app, with what Mantis must report. An issue matches an expectation when type, route and severity are equal and its selector is the expected selector (or a descendant selector of it, or the evidence.with element for overlaps). Cells use viewport/scheme/locale with * as wildcard; the cells reported for an expectation must be exactly these. The test also fails on any reported issue that matches no expectation.

bugs.title: Promo banner has a fixed 600px width
Nav kept on one line with overflow:hidden; the longer Vietnamese labels are cut off
bugs.where: styles.css .nav-links { max-width: 420px; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap }
bugs.fix: let the nav wrap (flex-wrap: wrap), no max-width / overflow:hidden

bugs.title: Menu toggle absolutely positioned on top of the header CTA on phones
bugs.fix: keep the toggle in the flex row

bugs.title: Hero image lazy-loaded after first paint without width/height
bugs.fix: width/height attributes (aspect ratio reserved) and a real src

bugs.title: Business pricing card hard-codes background #fff; in dark mode its light text becomes invisible
bugs.fix: use var(--surface) like the other cards

bugs.title: "Most popular" badge moved to the bottom of the card on phones, on top of the CTA label
bugs.fix: keep the badge at the top corner

bugs.title: Testimonial photo points at a file that was never uploaded

bugs.where: styles.css #newsletter-submit { width: 120px; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap }
